title: AWS Step Functions orchestration
summary: AWS Step Functions coordinates distributed work as state machines defined in Amazon States Language (ASL). Learn Task, Choice, Parallel, and Map states; Standard versus Express workflows; saga compensation patterns; and wiring Lambda and SQS into durable orchestration — the control plane senior engineers use when cron-plus-Lambda is no longer enough.

topics.title: Step Functions state types (Task, Choice, Parallel, Map)
Standard versus Express workflows (durability and cost)
Saga patterns with Step Functions (compensation and rollback)
Step Functions with Lambda and SQS (orchestrated workers)
